review_summary: The readable final sequence includes non-alert CBC EDR/NGAV evidence that discord.exe pid 4424 created c:\windows\system32\cmd.exe, and the cmd.exe pid 4872 block includes the observed command line C:\Windows\system32\cmd.exe /q /d /s /c "undefined\NVIDIA^ Corporation\NVSMI\nvidia-smi.exe". This recovers both C09 gold behaviors in order. The update.exe and intermediate Discord parent context, Discord file/registry activity, and Discord network connection are extra denominator content; alert summary text alone is not credited as non-alert evidence.

The readable final sequence recovers Discord.exe creating reg.exe from non-alert CBC procstart evidence, reg.exe pid 5424 querying HKCU\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Run\Discord, and reg.exe pid 5504 adding/updating the Discord Run value with non-alert CBC regmod evidence. These match C10-S01 through C10-S03 in order. The Discord existence or parent context and CBC alert rows are extra/supporting denominator content; alert summary text alone is not credited as non-alert evidence.
